visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with blonde hair in pigtails, wearing a white tank top and a black and white plaid shirt, stands in a brightly lit indoor room. She holds two boxes of Vivienne Westwood contact lenses and gestures enthusiastically toward the camera while introducing them. (2) Close-up shot focusing on her hands as she displays a silver blister pack containing a gray contact lens. Her nails are manicured with a delicate pattern, and the lighting is direct, highlighting the product's details. (3) The creator is shown wearing the 'Ash' gray contact lenses. She shifts her head and gaze to demonstrate how the lenses reflect light. A split-screen overlay appears at the bottom, providing an extreme close-up of both eyes for a clearer view of the lens pattern. (4) Transition to a close-up of a white box labeled 'Orb'. A pair of tweezers picks up a lens from a white circular lens case, emphasizing the hygiene and handling of the product. (5) Close-up of the woman wearing the 'Orb' lenses. She blinks and looks around, showing the subtle planet-shaped pattern on the iris. The background is a clean, neutral studio wall with soft, even lighting. (6) A selfie-style shot of the woman inside a car during the day. She wears a white plush hat with black polka dots. The natural daylight provides a different perspective on how the lenses look in everyday settings. (7) She presents the 'Beige' model, showing the brown-toned packaging and the lens inside the blister pack. (8) Wearing the 'Beige' lenses, the woman poses with her hand on her chin, smiling at the camera to show the warm, natural appearance of the brown lenses. (9) A series of quick cuts show her in various outfits and settings, including a professional studio shot with high-contrast cinematic lighting, summarizing her favorite styles from the collection.
